'''Docking Bay 87''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking area]] in the [[Coruscant Spaceport]], located on the edge of the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Race the Devil" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] arranged to meet the criminal [[Fabizan]] in the docking bay.<ref name="Race the Devil" />
